item.title: Radiothon in support of Women’s Resource Society coming to Fort St. John
item.description: The Fort St. John Women’s Resource Society Radiothon will be held by Moose FM at Festival Plaza on Friday, March 6th from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m., in support of Skye's Place, a program operated by the FSJWRS.

item.title: Energy regulator approves Taylor to Gordondale pipeline project
item.description: The Canada Energy Regulator has approved Pembina Pipeline's Taylor to Gordondale pipeline project for pre-construction preparations.

item.title: B.C. budget delays care homes, hospital and cancer facility, student housing
item.description: British Columbia’s budget delays seven long-term care projects, including in Fort St. John.

item.title: Tumbler Ridge shooting survivor cleared to return home following surgery
item.description: Paige Hoekstra, who survived the February 10th mass shooting at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School, has been cleared to return home.

item.title: Meet the Winter Fest 2026 ice carvers
item.description: Ice carvers showcased their masterpieces at the Winter Fest 2026 from February 13th to 16th at Centennial Park.

item.title: Construction of Fort St. John long-term care home delayed
item.description: Finance minister Brenda Bailey tabled her first budget on February 17th for 2026, including delays to seven projects around the province - one of which is the proposed long-term care home near the Fort St. John Hospital.
